description: Get an analytics summary for a date range. Returns total posts, status breakdown (published, failed, scheduled), per-platform stats, and daily post counts. Optional filters narrow every figure to matching posts; `compare` adds the equal-length previous window under `previous` (available for windows of 15 days or fewer — the 30-day statistics-retention cap applies). Use this when the user asks how their content performed overall, across channels and over a date range.

channelIds.description: Comma-separated channel ids to include, e.g. "12,15".

compare.description: Also return the previous equal-length window as `previous` / `previousWindow`.

labelIds.description: Comma-separated label ids; a post matches when it carries ANY of them.

mediaType.description: By the post's first media file: text (no media), image or video.

platforms.description: Comma-separated platform keys to include, e.g. "x,linkedin".

postFormat.description: Only single posts or only threads.

tz.description: IANA timezone (e.g. "Asia/Karachi") that sets where each day starts and ends and how daily counts are grouped. Defaults to UTC; pass the user's zone so 'today' and daily figures match their calendar.

name: get_analytics
title: Get analytics
